recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Follow up in HL7/api-incubator-ig or its publication process to publish the Operations for Large Resources page and add/remove/filter OperationDefinitions at stable URLs; update the core handoff URL only after a stable external target exists.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 Group issue requesting draft FMM 0 operations to support very large Groups, including limited/paged member retrieval, membership testing, expansion-like member listing, and memberOf-style searching.
initial_application: Commit 64dc56710e added source/operations-for-large-resources.html, Group/List notes links, and Resource large-resource add/remove/filter OperationDefinitions; 8f1052a2a0 added those operations to the Resource operations list. Later R5 follow-up commits for FHIR-39102 and FHIR-38923 refined links and PATCH/GraphQL trade-off guidance.
additional_context: The current build-scoped core page is informative and points to API Incubator. R6 commit 270e0ceb7b removed the detailed local operation narrative and deleted Resource-large-resource add/remove/filter OperationDefinitions from active core source. FHIR-I minutes and Zulip discussion in 2025 support moving this draft work into an IG/incubator space. The external HL7/api-incubator-ig repository contains the detailed operations page and OperationDefinition XML sources, although the probed build.fhir.org rendered API Incubator URLs currently return 404.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source change was made because restoring the R5 draft details would undo the later R6 handoff, and changing the handoff URL now would be speculative until the external IG has stable rendered pages.
